title: Why Diabetes Quietly Doubled, And Treatment Still Lags
hook: It quietly doubled, and most who have it still aren't treated.
closing: Doubling a disease is easy. Treating it is not.
question: Do you know your blood sugar numbers?

segments.say: In 1990, just 7 percent of adults worldwide had diabetes. By 2022, that doubled.
Only 45.8 percent of people with diabetes actually get treated for it.
High-income countries treat 53 percent of diabetes cases; poorer countries barely reach a third.
